    // True when x and y differ by no more than the given (non-negative) tolerance.
    AlmostEqual(x: IReal, y: IReal, tolerance: IReal): Boolean
        => (x - y).Abs <= tolerance;
```

## Line 189

    // True when x and y are close under the combined absolute+relative policy:
    // |x - y| <= tol.Absolute + tol.Relative * max(|x|, |y|). This is the library's
    // one numerical-comparison epsilon (see CONVENTIONS.md - Floating-point
    // comparison). Note: engineering Tolerance (uncertainty.types.plato) is an acceptance
    // allowance, NOT ComparisonTolerance, and does not belong here.
    AlmostEqual(x: Number, y: Number, tol: ComparisonTolerance): Boolean
        => (x - y).Abs <= tol.Absolute + tol.Relative * x.Abs.Greater(y.Abs);
```
